name: split
summary: Split a file into fixed-size pieces.
description: Writes consecutive sections of FILE to separate output files.

options.description: Place SIZE bytes per output file.
Place NUMBER lines per output file.

examples.title: Split a large archive
examples.explanation: Creates 100-megabyte pieces with a stable prefix.

examples.title: Split a log by line count
examples.explanation: Creates files containing at most 1000 lines each.

examples.title: Reassemble split pieces
examples.explanation: Concatenates the split pieces in lexical order to restore the original stream.
